root_cause.text: The register tracking in nft_exthdr_init() marks a user-controlled number of bytes (priv->len) as initialized via nft_parse_register_store(), but when NFT_EXTHDR_F_PRESENT is set, the eval path writes only 1 byte (or 4 bytes on error), creating a mismatch that leaves stack data uninitialized in registers beyond the actual write size.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if ((flags & NFT_EXTHDR_F_PRESENT) && len != 1) return -EINVAL;`, enforcing that len must be 1, which matches the fixed write size (nft_reg_store8) used when F_PRESENT is set. The commit message explicitly states that "when len > 4, registers beyond the first are never written, retaining uninitialized stack data from nft_regs."
